description: This file defines a PHP trait named ProjectServiceTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\Time\Traits\Service. It provides a method to access the ProjectService via dependency injection, utilizing a service container. The trait is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically within the time tracking plugin, and facilitates code reuse for accessing project-related services in classes that use this trait.

methods.name: getProjectService
methods.description: Provides access to the ProjectService instance via the service container.
